titel: Life Update: Hawaii, Cabo & Having a Second Baby!

einzeiler: Life update with family trips to Hawaii and Cabo, plus personal news and a show pause.
kurzfassung: The hosts reflect on their family-focused travels to Maui and Cabo San Lucas earlier in the year. They share major personal news about expecting their second child in June. Finally, they announce a temporary hiatus for the podcast to focus on this new chapter as a family of four.
stichpunkte: Reflecting on a two-week family trip to Maui in January
High travel costs and logistical hurdles of reaching Hawaii from Mexico
Exploring Cabo San Lucas and surrounding areas in Baja California South
Comparing the family-friendliness and pricing of Cabo versus other Mexican beach destinations
Sharing the announcement of expecting a second baby girl due in June
Pausing the podcast temporarily to settle in with a toddler and newborn

clips.hook: Longer travel time to Hawaii than to Japan
clips.text: The journey involved multiple flights connecting through Mexico City and Los Angeles, ending up taking significantly more time than a flight across the ocean to Asia.

clips.hook: Unbelievable restaurant prices for sushi rolls
clips.text: A casual dining experience featured individual sushi rolls priced between forty-five and fifty dollars.

clips.hook: A beach town that feels more like California than Mexico
clips.text: The heavy presence of Americanized tourism and widespread use of English created an atmosphere reminiscent of the US rather than a traditional Mexican location.

clips.hook: Keeping the pregnancy a secret until telling parents in person
clips.text: The hosts delayed sharing their big family news online because they wanted to inform their parents face-to-face during their trip to Hawaii.

clips.hook: Stepping away from the microphone for a temporary break
clips.text: The podcast is going on hiatus so the hosts can adjust to life with both a toddler and an infant.

beschreibung: This week on the podcast, we’re doing a bit of a life update, sharing about our recent trips to Hawaii and Cabo, as well as giving you some big personal news and show updates. We kick off the episode by talking about our first trip of 2024, which was a family trip to Maui, Hawaii. We talk about what it was like to visit Mauii post-pandemic and after the Lahaina fires, as well as share a little bit about what we did while we were there. We also talk about our trip to Cabo San Lucas, comparing it with other Mexican beach destinations and discussing travel logistics, accommodations, and activities. The episode concludes with some big personal news of expecting a second baby very soon, preparations for welcoming a second baby to the family, and discussing a temporary pause on the podcast to focus on family life. Enjoy!
